title: Bank-World: A Benchmark for Evaluating Agents on Banking Workflows
abstract: arXiv:2610.39733v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Bank-World is a benchmark of 50 banking tasks across two simulated institutions. Completing banking work requires more than producing the right calculation: agents must reconcile records, obtain permission, execute transactions, and keep instructions and status reports consistent as circumstances change. Bank-World tests these requirements through single-turn assignments and multi-turn interactions with simulated employees who supply information, approve actions, and revise instructions. Grading combines executable checks of recorded actions and state with model judgments of task requirements, including whether valid alternative solutions satisfy them. Across 1,600 attempts by four models, we find that correct decisions often fail to become completed work. Agents charge fees twice, distribute the correct total in incorrect amounts among the recipients, and execute payments while approval is pending. Their strengths also differ: Sol leads

translated_title: Bank-World：一个用于评估智能体在银行工作流程中表现的基准测试
translated_abstract: Bank-World 是一个包含 50 项银行任务、跨越两个模拟机构的基准测试。完成银行工作不仅仅是做出正确的计算：智能体必须核对记录、获得许可、执行交易，并在情况变化时保持指令和状态报告的一致性。Bank-World 通过单轮任务分配以及与模拟员工的多轮交互来测试这些要求，这些模拟员工会提供信息、批准操作并修改指令。评分方式结合了对已记录操作和状态的可执行检查，以及对任务要求的模型判断，包括判断有效的替代方案是否满足这些要求。在四个模型的 1,600 次尝试中，我们发现正确的决策往往未能转化为已完成的工作。智能体会重复收取费用、将正确的总额以错误的金额分配给各个收款人，或在审批仍处于待定状态时执行付款。它们的优势也各不相同：Sol 领先（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出了 Bank-World 基准测试，通过两个模拟机构中的 50 项单轮与多轮银行任务，评估 AI 智能体核对记录、获得审批和执行交易的能力，发现模型即使做出正确决策，也常常无法将其转化为正确完成的银行工作。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces Bank-World, a benchmark of 50 single-turn and multi-turn banking tasks across two simulated institutions that evaluates agents on reconciling records, obtaining approvals, and executing transactions, finding that correct decisions often fail to become correctly completed work.
